title: Gunger asks for some change

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Can you spare some change for a DuoRail ride home?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can you spare some change for a DuoRail ride home?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: If you own a business, like say a food stall, you can write off any donations for tax purposes. I used to own a business so I know this stuff.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you own a business, like say a food stall, you can write off any donations for tax purposes. I used to own a business so I know this stuff.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I owned a bakery. What, you think everyone living on the streets was born there?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I owned a bakery. What, you think everyone living on the streets was born there?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I have a place to stay on the East side. A better place. I don't know if it's safe anymore... but I need to go back and try. I won't last long here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a place to stay on the East side. A better place. I don't know if it's safe anymore... but I need to go back and try. I won't last long here.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: In the East it's all warehouses full of starship junk and derelict monorails and mad androids who think they're famous. I like it. And here... gangs, graffiti, drugs. But there's bad stuff too. Haha!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In the East it's all warehouses full of starship junk and derelict monorails and mad androids who think they're famous. I like it. And here... gangs, graffiti, drugs. But there's bad stuff too. Haha!

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: A hundred Lims would cover it. You can write off charity donations for tax purposes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A hundred Lims would cover it. You can write off charity donations for tax purposes.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Yes. What, you think I'm a drunk? Or a Joos head? Just because I'm on the street?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. What, you think I'm a drunk? Or a Joos head? Just because I'm on the street?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: The cold. That's what will get you in the end.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The cold. That's what will get you in the end.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you really going to spend the money on a HOVA ride?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you really going to spend the money on a HOVA ride?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you really going to spend the money on a HOVA ride?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you really going to spend the money on a HOVA ride?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you live on the street why do you need money to get home?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you live on the street why do you need money to get home?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you live on the street why do you need money to get home?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you live on the street why do you need money to get home?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is it really so much better on the East side?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is it really so much better on the East side?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is it really so much better on the East side?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is it really so much better on the East side?
